operations.historical_unknown_outcomes: Preserved as unknown, never replayed or relabeled by the release.
operations.package_image_correction: First stack update completed but strict guard caught mutable image lookup drift. Corrective deployment restored/pinned ami-02a9cdd4e98bc3c78. No package experiment admitted during that interval.

costs.estimates: Per-turn and job commitments are conservative admission reservations, not measured charges.
costs.unallocated: Existing EC2 worker hosting, extra 24 GiB of root storage, rollback snapshot, temporary repair infrastructure, local compute/storage, Lambda/Supabase hosting and subscription allowance allocation.

limitations: This is a production software release verification, not a new full scientific assessment of all 15 claims. Only one claim was selected, with six retained checks; remaining checks and final interpretation continue in the background.

The production PDF control follows the retained-plan path. Arbitrary papers and visual/supplement coverage are not validated by this one case; extracted text and five development excerpts do not establish complete literature review or perfect extraction.
New real-world Internet networking and custom EC2/container execution were not exercised in this release control; its executed run is archived bounded arithmetic.
A fresh Google OAuth round trip was not repeated. The real existing Google session and anonymous sign-in return paths were verified.

Raw model runtime artifact receipts identify retained HTTP SSE bytes; a legacy generic response_scope string also says provider HTTP bytes unavailable. Treat those specific artifact manifests as the available-byte record, not a claim of universal capture.

The existing worker now has a 48-GiB operational volume while its original launch declaration remains 24 GiB, avoiding instance replacement. Monitoring and an evidence-preserving spool retention policy remain follow-ups.
All substantive release answer review was performed by the AI implementer; no independent or human scientific review is claimed.
